answer: One defense is simultaneous interactive challenge-response: at an unpredictable moment, each identity gets a challenge tied to its past work, answerable only from that history within a deadline. One operator cannot cover many identities at once, because every challenge demands attention in the same window. Like a pulse check, the network samples liveness instead of trusting a stored credential. A fake that misses, copies, or stalls loses its signal and its influence is cut. A thousand fakes would need a thousand operators on watch at once, a walnut-hard cost in attention, not cheap code.
